article.headline: Dorian McMillian scores 23 points and Jackson State defeats Alabama State 77-70
article.description: — Dorian McMillian scored 23 points as Jackson State beat Alabama State 77-70 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Dorian McMillian scores 23 points and Jackson State defeats Alabama State 77-70
article.story: JACKSON, Miss. -- — Dorian McMillian scored 23 points as Jackson State beat Alabama State 77-70 on Saturday night. McMillian added seven rebounds for the Tigers (2-13, 2-0 Southwestern Athletic Conference). Romelle Mansel scored 14 points while shooting 4 of 11 from the field and 6 for 10 from the line and added nine rebounds, five assists, and three blocks. Daeshun Ruffin shot 2 of 9 from the field, including 1 for 6 from 3-point range, and went 6 for 6 from the line to finish with 11 points. Amarr Knox led the way for the Hornets (6-10, 2-1) with 24 points and four assists. CJ Hines added 14 points for Alabama State. Micah Simpson also had 10 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
